audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers had Singed winning levels 2 and 3 and first item, and the lane even at 4-5 and 6 — the exact opposite of what the whys on those rows say.
audit.why: The mirror audit already settled this chart as Skill / Kennen / Kennen / Singed / Kennen / Kennen / Singed, which is also the packet chart. whys[1] and whys[2] are Kennen windows, whys[3] concedes 4-5, whys[4] and whys[5] are Kennen spikes.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 flipped in matched pairs to match the mirror and the packet. Rows 0 and 6 were already right.

audit.why: Level 6 (Slicing Maelstrom, 120s flat) and first item are Kennen's real spikes; Singed's are Rylai's and Liandry's. Ordering was right once the chart was re-sided.
audit.corrected: Spike text keeps the same timings, with Fling's 10/9.5/9/8.5/8 and Mega Adhesive's 17s added where they make the advice concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page credits Singed with a heal in four places — 'his passive heals it all back', 'his drain out-sustains your poke', 'a drain-tank', 'his healing fights your pattern' — and claims Fling 'interrupts your channel'.
audit.why: Singed's passive is Noxious Slipstream: a burst of move speed when he passes a champion. There is no heal anywhere in his kit; the only healing-related effect is Insanity Potion putting Grievous Wounds on his Poison Trail, which cuts YOUR sustain. And Kennen's Slicing Maelstrom carries no channel flag, so a Fling knockup does not turn it off.
audit.corrected: Every heal claim removed and replaced with what actually grinds you down (poison tick plus stacked HP); the passive named correctly; the anti-heal item line rewritten around his Grievous Wounds.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Fling-into-Mega-Adhesive root was never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's text: if the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted. That converts his flip from a repositioning tool into a full lockdown on a champion with 22 base HP per level, and it is the actual reason you never fight on top of the goo.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[1].d, mid and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: Fling was tracked as an abstract 'flip'.
audit.why: It is 125 range — melee range — on 10s at rank 1. Stated that way, the advice becomes a positioning rule rather than a cooldown count: stay outside melee and it never lands. Mega Adhesive at 1000 range and 17s is the ability that actually reaches you.
audit.corrected: Both numbers written into the cooldown fields and dosFull[0].d.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Fling's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His window: Noxious Slipstream speed and Poison Trail let him sidestep your Q and concede nothing. Chip and refuse the commit.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. E-dash/dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — 125 range, 10s at rank 1; he must reach melee to use it. - Mega Adhesive: 1000 range, 17s — flung into it you are rooted, not slowed. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: His flip. E-dash/dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A 125-range flip on 10s. Stay outside melee and it never lands.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.

edits.before: Track Singed's Fling: His flip. E-dash/dodge it. When it is down — Stun-stack + R him.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Liandry's Torment  (burn poke), then Shadowflame; boots Mercury's Treads. Anti-heal (Oblivion Orb / Executioner's) early — his healing fights your pattern.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Liandry's Torment  (burn poke), then Shadowflame; boots Mercury's Treads. Insanity Potion puts Grievous Wounds on his poison — don't plan on healing through it.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom + Zhonya wins any grouped fight top-side — build your teamfight around that. Singed carry threat: 7/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom + Zhonya wins any grouped fight top-side — build your teamfight around that. Singed carry threat: 7/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he is ahead, and never chase him through poison.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom stun-locks him through the poison and Q-W-E-Flash-R is the one all-in that pins a drain-tank long enough to burst him.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom stun-locks him through the poison and Q-W-E-Flash-R is the one all-in that pins a champion who otherwise just walks away.

edits.before: With Rylai's and Liandry's his drain out-sustains your poke and his move speed plus slow run you down on R cooldown — don't sidelane him, fight with your team.
edits.after: With Rylai's and Liandry's the HP he stacks out-grinds your poke, and Noxious Slipstream plus the slow runs you down on R cooldown — don't sidelane him.

edits.before: Q-W-E-Flash-R stun-locks him out of his own kit — the only window where Slicing Maelstrom holds him still long enough to actually kill a drain-tank.
edits.after: Q-W-E-Flash-R stun-locks him out of his own kit — the only window where Slicing Maelstrom holds still a champion whose entire answer is walking away.

edits.before: Hextech Alternator or Liandry's cashes the R combo into burst that beats his pre-Liandry's/Rylai sustain — your cleanest kill window.
edits.after: Hextech Alternator or Liandry's cashes the R combo into burst that beats his HP before Rylai's lands — your cleanest kill window all game.

edits.before: His Fling, poison trail and Rylai's slow let him run you down on R cooldown; your squishy caster body can't escape his move speed and he out-sustains every poke.
edits.after: Fling, Poison Trail and Rylai's let him run you down on R cooldown; Noxious Slipstream hands him speed off every champion he passes and you cannot outrun that.

edits.before: Singed never trades back early, so this is your window to chip — Q from max range and let Electrical Surge on-hit autos do work, but never stand in his poison trail to do it or his passive heals it all back. The trap is Fling: if you E-in to stack your third Mark of the Storm and he Flings you, you eat the poison and get tossed under tower. At level 2-3, if he steps up to last-hit, a Q plus W on-hit can land your third-mark stun before he reacts.
edits.after: Singed never trades back early, so this is your window to chip — Q from 950 and let Electrical Surge on-hit autos do work, but never stand in his poison trail to do it or the tick outruns your chip. The trap is Fling: it is only 125 range, so if you E-in to stack your third Mark of the Storm he flips you into the poison and under tower. At level 2-3, if he steps up to last-hit, a Q plus W on-hit lands your third-mark stun before he reacts.

edits.before: At 4-5 he gets slippery — his move speed and poison let him sidestep your Q and you can't commit without burning E, so chip and respect Fling here. Level 6 flips it hard: Slicing Maelstrom stun-locks him through the poison, and Q-W-E-Flash-R is the one combo that holds a drain-tank still long enough to kill. Force every all-in on his Fling cooldown — that toss is the only thing that interrupts your channel.
edits.after: At 4-5 he gets slippery — Noxious Slipstream speed and poison let him sidestep your Q and you can't commit without burning E, so chip and respect Fling here. Level 6 flips it hard: Slicing Maelstrom stun-locks him through the poison, and Q-W-E-Flash-R is the one combo that holds him still long enough to kill. Never commit on top of Mega Adhesive: flung into that goo you are rooted, not slowed.

edits.before: This is where he reclaims the lane. Once he has Rylai's and Liandry's, your poke can't out-damage his drain sustain, and his move speed plus the slow run your squishy body down the moment Slicing Maelstrom is on cooldown. You cannot duel him in a sidelane late — pivot to teamfights where your AoE R peels and engages for your team, and let your carries deal with a Singed who just wants to fling and proxy. Close on your 6/first-item spike or this becomes his game.
edits.after: This is where he reclaims the lane. Once he has Rylai's and Liandry's, your poke can't out-damage the HP he stacks, and Noxious Slipstream plus the slow run your squishy body down the moment Slicing Maelstrom's 120s is running. You cannot duel him in a sidelane late — pivot to teamfights where your AoE R peels and engages for your team, and let your carries deal with a Singed who just wants to fling and proxy. Close on your 6/first-item spike or this is his game.

edits.before: Land Fling to flip your stun chain and toss you into his poison cloud and tower
edits.after: Land Fling to toss you into Mega Adhesive, where the landing roots you cold

edits.before: Drag you through the poison trail so his passive sustain heals every trade you make
edits.after: Drag you through the poison trail so its tick damage wins every trade you make

notes: Singed was written as a drain-tank with a healing passive. He has neither: Noxious Slipstream is a move-speed burst off passing champions, and the only healing effect in his kit is Insanity Potion applying Grievous Wounds to HIS poison — which cuts Kennen's sustain, so the page's 'buy anti-heal, his healing fights your pattern' line was backwards. Added the Fling-into-Mega-Adhesive root, which was absent and is the reason not to fight on the goo. Chart re-sided to the mirror's settled version. Also removed the claim that Fling interrupts Slicing Maelstrom — Kennen's R carries no channel flag.
